summary.description: The human summary, in the user's language, as markdown. What changed and where, in a few lines. Do NOT include the coherence findings here — they go in the `findings` array, one entry each.

findings.description: EVERY coherence finding you were given, one entry each, rewritten in the user's language. Same order, same count — a finding you leave out is a defect nobody hears about. Say which ones this run caused. Empty only when you were given none.
